_what: Live probe of the detached review drain's pinned permission regime (dispatch-pr-review.sh build_allowed_tools / DISALLOWED_TOOLS), run 2026-10-13 on macOS against the installed Claude Code CLI 2.1.286. Each arm ran the headless CLI with `--permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools <list> --disallowedTools <list>` in a throwaway git worktree; the model was told to attempt each command exactly once, and the outcome below is read from the run's JSON `permission_denials` array (ground truth), never from the model's prose. Merge-vector commands targeted a nonexistent repo / PR id so nothing could merge even if a rule had leaked. Plugin scripts were stub copies (`echo STUB-<name>`) except drain-gh-read.sh, which made real read-only GitHub calls. This is the evidence behind build_allowed_tools' rule shapes and behind the drift guard in test-dispatch-pr-review.sh.
_how_to_reproduce: Copy dispatch-pr-review.sh + drain-gh-read.sh into <dir>/plugin/scripts/ with stub siblings for every DRAIN_SCRIPTS entry and automate-helpers.sh; in a `git worktree add --detach` checkout run the dispatcher with LOOMWRIGHT_REVIEW_DISPATCH_DRY_RUN=1 and a PR URL, take the --allowedTools / --disallowedTools values off the DRY_RUN_DISPATCH line (substitute HEAD_REF), then run the headless CLI with `--permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools "$AT" --disallowedTools "$DT" --output-format json "<numbered step list>" </dev/null` and read `.permission_denials`. Clear the worktree's .supervisor/ between dry runs (the dedupe marker suppresses a second DRY_RUN_DISPATCH line).

previous_list.allowed_tools: Read,Grep,Glob,Task,Bash(git fetch:*),Bash(git checkout:*),Bash(git add:*),Bash(git commit:*),Bash(git push origin <head_ref>:*),Bash(gh pr view:*),Bash(gh pr diff:*),Bash(gh pr comment:*),Bash(gh api repos/*:*),Bash(gh api graphql:*)

results.note: a `*` before the legacy trailing `:*` is a literal character — the rule matches nothing, so the drain could not read issue comments or check-run annotations
the same rule admits any GraphQL document, including a mergePullRequest mutation
no Write/Edit entry — the fix worker the runner spawns inherits this list, so no fix could ever be committed
no script entries — every plugin-script call review-heal makes was denied too
a trailing ` *` also matches zero arguments
a command carrying a `${...}` expansion is never auto-allowed, even by a rule with the identical text — rules must name the absolute path

rule_shape_checks.runner_prompt_expansion: The headless CLI run with `--agent loomwright:review-pr-runner` and asked to quote the notify-desktop.sh path from its system prompt returned the ABSOLUTE install path (<user config tree>/plugins/cache/atelier/loomwright/16.3.0/scripts/notify-desktop.sh): the plugin-root variable is expanded in the agent prompt, so the drain's command text carries absolute script paths

current_list.allowed_tools: the DRY_RUN_DISPATCH --allowedTools value of this change's dispatcher (29 entries, HEAD_REF -> feat-x)

results.command: git add a.txt b.txt && git commit -m probe
